notes.title: The Future of Astravelari
notes.content:
Greetings!

It has been over a year since the release of Phantom Project and despite the unsuccessful crowdfunding attempts, we sincerely thank all of the players who supported the game in its prototype state and kept the company afloat. Our game development journey continues and it is all thanks to you.

Phantom Project is labor-intensive in terms of game development due to the massive interior setting. It is due to this design decision that the full game cannot be made with little to no resources. However, we looked at our roadmap of games that we want to create and there are titles that can be created with minimal resources so we started pre-production last April and will slowly transition to production next year. Moreover, Phantom Project will no longer be updated in the future as we need to focus on the next title.

To the generous Indiegogo patrons of Phantom Project who took a leap of faith and believed in us, all of our future digital products will be available to you for free and if you purchased the credits perk, your name will be in the credits of every future game that we create. We still owe you so we'll make your faith in us worth something to be proud of in our next title.

To the good people who translated the game for free and to the players who purchased Phantom Project and gave us a positive review before this day, you will receive a free digital copy of the next game including all DLCs. Please note that the players did not know this beforehand and this will only be done once since we do not bribe players for positive reviews. Please preserve the email addresses and Steam accounts that you used to reach us.

There will be a trailer for our next title near the end of 2023 or early 2024 so please stay tuned by subscribing to our YouTube channel.

Thank you very much.



Sincerely,

Astravelari Team

notes.title: Speedrun and Race to Ending B!
notes.content:
Greetings paranormal investigators!

So far, we haven't seen a video of anyone completing Ending B so we've launched this event for players who are up for the challenge. You may read the mechanics below:



Phantom Project Race

• Complete the game on Ending B Normal or Hard while recording your FULL gameplay.
• Upload your playthrough on YouTube and title it Phantom Project Race.
• Use Phantom Project in the Game title under Category in the Video details so we can easily find your video.
• The first 10 players will have their channel names listed on a file that will be posted on the bulletin board in the game in the next update.
• This event will end as soon as 10 players have been confirmed.
• We will confirm via comment on your video so please allow comments on your video.



Phantom Project Speedrun

• Complete the game on Ending B Hard while recording your FULL gameplay with NO cuts in the middle.
• Upload your playthrough on YouTube and title it Phantom Project Speedrun followed by your record time as shown in the ending. Example: Phantom Project Speedrun 00 : 11 : 54
• Use Phantom Project in the Game title under Category in the Video details so we can easily find your video.
• The top 10 players will have their channel names listed on a file that will be posted on the bulletin board in the game in the next update.
• This event will end when the month of January 2022 is over using the GMT +00:00 timezone.
• We will confirm via comment on your video so please allow comments on your video.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41280087/4b22a1dcd463a7f4d7d0af9df1a2418f1e151c72.png
We've relaunched our Indiegogo campaign so you can support Phantom Project at www.astravelari.com! Please follow us on Facebook and Twitter for more exciting news and join us on Discord if you want to provide feedback or report bugs. You can subscribe to our channel at YouTube if you want to watch developer videos and you can watch Developer Log 1 here. 

In other news, we fixed a bug with the Videotape Player where it continues to play after the Power Plug has been removed.



Cheers,

Astravelari Team

• The Videotape Player automatically rewinds after it finishes playing and can be replayed by stopping it and then playing it again.
• The old EXAMINE that automatically opens the inventory has now been changed to simply display the girl's thoughts as subtitles.
• New scary bits have been added. ːsteammockingː
• The maid's hair now has physics.
• The maids look more distinct from one another.
• Ambient lighting is slightly brighter.
• Some enemies no longer spawn in some areas on EASY and NORMAL.
• Doors that lead to areas that are under construction can no longer be interacted with.
• Improved the overall quality of in-game music and sound effects.
• The starting HP has been changed to 100% for easy, 75% for normal and 50% for hard.
• The Cookies have been split so one is in one room and two are in another room.
• Fixed a bug where you can get stuck between the storage room door and a cart.
• Fixed a bug where marble floors did not produce footstep sounds.
• Fixed a bug where releasing a cart can sometimes prevent walking and running animations.
• Fixed an animation glitch that occurs at high frame rates.

notes.title: October 25, 2021 Update
notes.content:
Greetings paranormal investigators!

Like always, we've been watching your videos and reading your feedback to see how we can further improve the game. More changes are pending and will be implemented in the near future but the current changes are listed below.

• Updated the enemy AI in the upper and lower quarters making it possible for players who have not yet solved the riddle to still have a chance to survive as long as they tread carefully.

• Updated the layout of the dormitory due to fan feedback regarding the trip from the top floor to the bottom floor being too tedious. A second elevator was installed and will be functional in the future.

• Thank you and congratulations beinbeinbein ベイン for getting the Supernatural Tier! You may read your letter from Cynthia Lawson in the mailbox! Thank you Juan Cordente for getting the Ghastly Tier!

• Fixed an issue where the player gets stuck between a wall and a spawning enemy.

• Fixed an issue where the moonlight does not cast a shadow from a distance when the shadow quality is lower than ultra.

• Fixed an issue where the image for the brightness setting gets noisy when the anti-aliasing quality is lower than high.

Thank you very much for playing the game and for providing important feedback. As of now, we have more than 2700 players all over the world and it has only been 12 days. Please support us at www.astravelari.com as we continue to develop and campaign for the full game.



Cheers,

Astravelari Team

notes.title: October 20, 2021 Update
notes.content:
Greetings paranormal investigators!

We've seen a lot of your videos and we've listened to your feedback so we decided to update a few things.

• When the opening cutscene's script was being written, it actually had three objectives but only two were accomplished in the previous versions. The three objectives were to create an emotional connection between the player and the little girl, to show that there is a threat while still employing the fear of the unknown, and to show that the little girl is trying to accomplish something without revealing too much. We've finally figured out a scene that works with the final objective and so the opening cutscene was slightly modified.

• When it comes to giving players an objective, we'd rather show than tell so we don't just flash text that shows the objective somewhere on the screen. Instead, we'd like players to figure out the objective based on observation. Having said that, we've made changes to make the objective a lot easier to figure out.

• The inventory now remembers where you last looked. For example, if you look at a file and close the inventory, if you open it up again you will see the file that you last saw instead of the item tab.

Thank you very much for your feedback and stay tuned as we continue to update the game.



Cheers,

Astravelari Team

notes.title: October 14, 2021 Update
notes.content:
Greetings paranormal investigators!

We've been watching your playthroughs and we've released a small update to slightly tweak the difficulty and to clarify a few things that do not set the right expectations. The changes are listed below.

• The game previously starts at 70% HP but we've changed it to start at 100% HP.

• The COOKIE item that recovers health now has three pieces instead of one.

• The LOAD GAME, CONTINUE, COSTUMES and GALLERY menu options have been removed since they are not yet implemented.

• The game has one ending in its current prototype state. The multiple endings previously listed in the RECORDS menu have been removed and only the scores for the three difficulties, EASY, NORMAL and HARD, will be shown.

• Fixed a few pathfinding issues for the Maid's AI.

Please feel free to provide us more feedback to improve the game. Thank you very much and always remember that it's all part of the test.



Cheers,

Astravelari Team
